title: Evidence attestation gap
description: attestation-gap.json in an evidence/v1 export: the statement that a Closed change has no attestation, with the reason. It is present exactly when attestation.json is absent. A gap is incomplete evidence, never a pass. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; reason is 1 to 512 bytes of valid UTF-8 made of printable characters; the file is at most 1 MiB.

export_version.description: The export layout version; 1 in evidence/v1.

reason.description: Why the attestation was not made; 1 to 512 bytes of printable UTF-8.
